_what: First compile of an omega-GENERATED plan. Dry-run: no apply.

responseVerbatim.message: Custom section 'custom:18c11ae8-bb26-5025-a01c-957043d42445' does not belong to this strategy.

_what2: ATTEMPT 1 of 2. The payload was wire() as of commit cb7cfb0, whose custom sections still carried omega's deterministic custom:<uuid5> sectionKeys.
_interpretation: REFUSED - OMEGA GAP, not a platform defect. On CREATE the server accepts NO client-supplied custom sectionKey (allowedDomain enum is empty): a strategy that does not exist yet owns no section identities, the server mints them. Doc 16 already said 'omit it; the server mints one' for the compile arm; wire() was claiming identities anyway. The schema permits the key syntactically (optional, pattern-matched) and the runtime refuses every value - a schema/validator looseness, but the typed error is precise and coherent. Fixed same day: wire() strips sectionKey from custom sections (the deterministic keys stay on the local Report for identity); guard test test_create_sections_carry_no_client_section_key pins it. Attempt 2 (compile_dry_run_2026-08-28.json) got PAST this stage, confirming the fix.
